doc.title: Houston Person Part 2 interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, October 2, 1998 [interview 2 of 2]

title: Jazz cruises on the Norway
summary: Person describes regular jazz cruises on The Norway, with Meet the Artists series and jam sessions, where bands bring their own group.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: Well the last time I saw you guys was a pretty nice situation on that cruise ship.
It’s interesting, some venues have shrunk for jazz, others have opened up.
I guess that’s probably a pretty good gig to get, those kinds of things.
Yeah. Because we’ll be going on The Norway in October. We’ve been going on that for the last five or six years. That’s been great.

Oh well the audience is there just for that. So if you’re going to spend your cruise money, you’re going to get your money’s worth. No it’s a great cruise too because they have Meet the Artists Series, autograph sessions, record sales sessions, and jam sessions, the whole thing, so it’s great.
Do you get to bring your own band?
You get to bring your own band. That’s very important. Yeah. So you’ll see it all — everybody doing their thing, the way they do it, and then you’ll catch a lot of jam sessions.
